description: Trainerrr helps signed-in users manage workout plans, reusable sessions, completed workout logs, training journal notes, weekly progress check-ins, nutrition logs, food lookups, and personal fitness targets through ChatGPT. It processes the workout, nutrition, target, journal, progress-check-in, and image-reference details users choose to send so it can complete requested actions for their Trainerrr account.
